clauses.scope_note: CC-BY-SA-4.0 Section 2(a)(5)(c): You may not offer or impose additional or different terms or apply Effective Technological Measures to Licensed Material if they restrict a recipient's exercise of Licensed Rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: restricts_recipient_exercise_of_licensed_rights means the terms or measures restrict any recipient's exercise of Licensed Rights. The text covers both offering or imposing terms and applying measures.

obligation_items.content: Do not offer or impose additional or different terms or conditions, or apply Effective Technological Measures, to Licensed Material in a way that restricts a recipient's exercise of Licensed Rights.
obligation_items.trigger: When offering or imposing terms or applying Effective Technological Measures to Licensed Material, if those terms or measures would restrict any recipient's exercise of Licensed Rights.

clauses.condition_explanation: asserts_or_implies_official_connection_or_endorsement means representing such a connection, sponsorship, endorsement, or official status. This does not prohibit merely mentioning the Licensor.

obligation_items.content: Do not assert or imply that You or Your use of Licensed Material is connected with, sponsored, endorsed, or granted official status by the Licensor or designated attribution recipients.

clauses.scope_note: CC-BY-SA-4.0 Section 2(b)(3): to the extent possible, the Licensor waives royalties from You for exercise of Licensed Rights under voluntary or waivable statutory or compulsory licensing schemes; in all other cases the Licensor expressly reserves royalty-collection rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: royalties_are_voluntary_or_waivable_under_applicable_scheme identifies only the royalty-waiver category stated in the clause. The waiver is qualified by 'to the extent possible'; no broader royalty-free grant is inferred.

clauses.scope_note: CC-BY-SA-4.0 Section 3(a)(1), partial text: when You Share Licensed Material, including in modified form, the listed supplied attribution information must be retained. The source chunk ends at item (v); this clause does not establish that the listed items exhaust the attribution conditions.
clauses.condition_explanation: shares_licensed_material follows the license definition of Share: providing material to the public by a means requiring permission under Licensed Rights, including making it publicly accessible at individually chosen times or places. Each retention predicate applies only if the respective information or notice was supplied with the Licensed Material. The URI predicate is qualified by reasonable practicability; identification must be retained in any reasonable manner requested by the Licensor, including by designated pseudonym.

obligation_items.trigger: When You Share Licensed Material, including in modified form, and the identification was supplied by the Licensor with the Licensed Material.

obligation_items.object: Copyright notice supplied with the Licensed Material
obligation_items.trigger: When You Share Licensed Material, including in modified form, and the notice was supplied by the Licensor with the Licensed Material.

obligation_items.content: Retain the supplied notice referring to the disclaimer of warranties.

obligation_items.trigger: When You Share Licensed Material, including in modified form, and the notice was supplied by the Licensor with the Licensed Material.

obligation_items.content: Include a URI or hyperlink to the Licensed Material to the extent reasonably practicable.

obligation_items.trigger: When You Share Licensed Material, including in modified form, to the extent providing the URI or hyperlink is reasonably practicable.

Those are operative offers by the Licensor, not actions of You; the available activity/object schema does not faithfully represent them.

Section 2(b)(1) states that moral, publicity, privacy, and similar personality rights are not licensed, while describing a limited Licensor waiver to the extent possible. Section 2(b)(2) expressly excludes patent and trademark rights. These scope boundaries are not represented as behavioral permissions or prohibitions here.
